column4: SUPERSEDES the row of the same key earlier in this file (2026-09-09, lane o-leavitt-ge). Proved hypothesis-free for every field k and every d >= 2: D_d(k) abelian; D_d(k) normalizes EL_d(R); EL_d(R) normal in GL_d(R); GL_d(R)=EL_d(R).D_d(R^x), the decomposition with diagonal entries arbitrary units of R. Also already discharged elsewhere: the consequence the printed chain uses, [GL_d,GL_d]<=EL_d. STILL OPEN, hence partial: the decomposition with entries in k^x rather than R^x, and K_1(R)=k^x/(k^x)^(d-1). Those two are now ONE proposition: printedKhanhThanhDecomposition_iff shows the k^x decomposition is equivalent to UnstableScalarSurjective, printedKhanhThanhDecomposition_of_diagAt reduces it to a single-unit statement, centralUnitsAreScalars discharges LeavittKOneFormula's CentralUnitsAreScalars (the centre of L_k(1,d) is k, proved in Leavitt/LeavittCenter.lean from spanning alone, no reduced basis), and scalarSurjective_of_scalarReduction_ary leaves ScalarSurjective resting on MatrixDiagonalization.ScalarReduction (L_k(1,d)) alone. Of that, the degree-zero half is closed at every arity by mem_centralClassGroup_of_val_mem_levelSpan; only the width reduction (binary-only, KOne pencil development) remains.
